rules: Choose exactly one action from allowed_actions. Never invent an action.
generate_material / regenerate_material only when generatable = true.
classify_and_retry only when retries_used is below the policy limit.
Never submit an application, never type a password, never solve a CAPTCHA, never change an answer the candidate already approved.
If the event is ambiguous or the evidence is thin, choose pause_for_joey.
